repos_data.description: A high-performance, recursive DNS resolver server with DNSSEC support, focused on preserving privacy.
The NLnet Labs Name Server Daemon (NSD) is an authoritative, RFC compliant DNS nameserver.

repo_meta_data.description: YADIFA is a lightweight authoritative Name Server with DNSSEC capabilities. Developed by the passionate people behind the .eu top-level domain, YADIFA has been built from scratch to face today’s DNS challenges, with no compromise on security, speed and stability, to offer a better and safer Internet experience.
